sections.description: The Free ST HVAC WordPress Theme is a clean, modern and easy to use theme crafted for HVAC businesses, heating and cooling companies, air conditioning contractors, furnace repair experts, ventilation and duct cleaning services, refrigeration technicians, boiler installers, chimney sweeps, solar heating providers, plumbers, electricians, handyman services, home improvement firms and other residential or commercial trade businesses. Built for both new contractors and well established service companies, it lets you launch a professional website without touching a single line of code. Every section is fully responsive, so your pages stay sharp and readable across desktops, laptops, tablets and smartphones. The well organised layout gives you room to present your service list, share customer reviews, map out the areas you cover, announce seasonal offers or emergency call out numbers, and place your contact details where visitors can find them instantly, which helps turn casual traffic into real enquiries and booked jobs. The theme is lightweight and follows WordPress coding standards, so pages load quickly and run smoothly even on busy sites. It is built with SEO in mind and pairs well with popular SEO plugins, giving you easy control over page titles, meta descriptions, headings and structured content so your business ranks better in local search. It is also compatible with widely used WordPress plugins such as contact forms, appointment and booking tools, quote request forms, live chat, WooCommerce and leading page builders, making customisation quick and flexible. Translation ready, RTL friendly and cross browser tested, the theme also offers custom logo support, custom colours, custom menus, featured images, threaded comments, a full width template and handy theme options. Whether your work covers HVAC installation, AC repair, heating maintenance, ventilation, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical or any other home and commercial service, this theme gives you a solid, dependable base for growing your online presence and winning more customers.
